fit_solution_set.representation: Each node value is its stored potential plus t[component] modulo m. All glyph values are pairwise distinct. This finite constraint set is exactly all solutions, with no representative selected.
fit_solution_set.cross_component_condition: For every pair of components a!=b and each glyph g in a, h in b: t[a]+potential[g] != t[b]+potential[h] modulo m.
